claim_boundary: This boundary records ROADMAP dispositions for all 55 PDF-verified named AlphaEvolve structural spans, including sections, figures, tables, appendices, source pages, local status, roadmap section, phase bucket, sidecars, and active audit TODO links, plus 514 bounded claim-level records: 50 Table 1/Section 2 system requirements and 41 Abstract, Introduction, Discussion, and collaborator-context claims, plus 41 Section 3.1, Table 2, Figure 4, and footnote 3 matrix-result claims, plus 63 Section 3.2 and Figure 5 constructive-math claims, plus 45 Section 3.3 opening, Section 3.3.1, and Figure 6 scheduling claims, plus 59 Section 3.3.2 and Figure 7 kernel-engineering claims, plus 35 Section 3.3.3 hardware-circuit-design claims, plus 44 Section 3.3.4 compiler-generated-code claims, plus 51 Section 4 and Figure 8 ablation claims, plus 85 Section 5 Related Work claims separated into 59 source-context-only and 26 implementation-relevant claims. It does not claim whole-paper sentence-, paragraph-, equation-, footnote-, citation-, or requirement-level exhaustiveness, a claim-level application-result matrix, complete paper-index row to ROADMAP disposition map, proof that every missing or partial source span has a live TODO, or a CI source-span exhaustiveness gate.
